class.name: TickCodec
class.brief_description: Network encoding of a synchronized variable.
class.description: A [TickCodec] defines how a variable declared with [method TickObject.declare_var] is written, how much it's quantized, how two values are compared and how they are interpolated. The server and the predicting client quantize the state with the codec every tick, so identical simulations produce identical values and don't cause rewinds. Two values are considered equal when they differ by no more than [method get_tolerance]. [codeblock] func _setup_sync(): declare_var("position", TickCodec.vector3(TickCodec.PRECISION_HALF)) declare_var("velocity", TickCodec.vector3_ranged(-20.0, 20.0, 12)) declare_var("quaternion", TickCodec.quaternion(10)) [/codeblock]

method.name: boolean
method.description: Returns a codec for [bool] values, in 1 bit.

method.name: get_bits
method.description: Returns the number of bits of integer, ranged and quaternion codecs.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of value this codec encodes.

method.name: get_precision
method.description: Returns the precision of the floating point based codecs.

method.name: get_tolerance
method.description: Returns the largest difference for two values to be considered equal: absolute for ranged codecs, relative to the magnitude for [constant KIND_REAL], [constant KIND_VECTOR2] and [constant KIND_VECTOR3]. Defaults to half of the quantization step.

method.name: integer
method.description: Returns a codec for signed [int] values in [param bits] bits (1 to 64), clamped to the range of that size.

method.name: interpolate
method.description: Returns the value between [param from] and [param to] at [param weight] (0 to 1). Discrete values (booleans, integers, [method variant]) keep [param from] until [param weight] reaches 1.

method.name: is_equal
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param a] and [param b] differ by no more than [method get_tolerance].

method.name: normalized_vector2
method.description: Returns a codec for directions ([Vector2] of length 1, or zero), stored as an angle.

method.name: normalized_vector3
method.description: Returns a codec for directions ([Vector3] of length 1, or zero).

method.name: quantize
method.description: Returns [param value] as the other peers receive it.

method.name: quaternion
method.description: Returns a codec for rotations ([Quaternion]) with the smallest three encoding: 2 bits plus [param bits_per_component] bits for each of three components.

method.name: real
method.description: Returns a codec for [float] values: 64, 32 or 16 bits according to [param precision].

method.name: real_ranged
method.description: Returns a codec for [float] values between [param min] and [param max], quantized uniformly in [param bits] bits (1 to 32). Values outside the range are clamped.

method.name: set_tolerance
method.description: Overrides the default tolerance of [method is_equal].

method.name: variant
method.description: Returns a codec for any [Variant] (without objects), encoded without compression and compared exactly. Up to 65535 bytes.

method.name: vector2
method.description: Returns a codec for [Vector2] values; each component is encoded as in [method real].

method.name: vector2_ranged
method.description: Returns a codec for [Vector2] values; each component is encoded as in [method real_ranged].

method.name: vector3
method.description: Returns a codec for [Vector3] values; each component is encoded as in [method real].

method.name: vector3_ranged
method.description: Returns a codec for [Vector3] values; each component is encoded as in [method real_ranged].

constants.constant: Encodes a [Vector2] with components in a range.
Encodes a [Vector3] with components in a range.
64 bits reals; the finest level for directions.
16 bits reals; the coarsest level for directions.
